audit_notes.findings: No vulnerabilities detected. The code follows security best practices:
security_strengths: All secrets loaded from environment variables (no hardcoded credentials)
Proper error handling for missing environment variables
Timing-safe comparison used in password verification (crypto.timingSafeEqual)
Password verification uses PBKDF2 with appropriate parameters
Getter functions prevent exposure of secrets at module-import time
Safe handling of malformed password hashes with try-catch
recommendations: Consider using bcrypt library for production password hashing
Implement rate limiting for login attempts
Add logging for security events (failed logins, missing env vars)
Consider implementing KMS for private key management
